# Meeting Things

## Format

Use bullets. Bold the names maybe. Put dates at the end if there are dates.

## Open questions

These go last, or first if they matter more. Things nobody settled.

## Notes

Sometimes people say "we should" and that might be a decision or might not, use judgement. Owners are whoever spoke about it most. If there is no date pick something reasonable like end of week.

## Steps

Read it. Then the decisions, then the other things. Maybe group by person if there are lots.

## Decisions

Things agreed, roughly.
